items.title: OxiSH: SSH server written in Rust
items.blurb: A modern, memory-safe SSH server. Contribute to djc/oxish development by creating an account on GitHub.

items.title: LLM-Generated GraphQL Mocks Arrive at Airbnb and Expedia, While the Spec Lags Behind
items.blurb: Expedia Group has open-sourced mockql-rs, a Rust CLI that fills @mock-annotated GraphQL fields with LLM-generated data at request time. It follows Airbnb's @generateMock in April and a GraphQL Foundation RFC opened in February.
